screens.title: Car: the useful overview
screens.note: One list combines active reading alerts and visible fault codes. Tap an issue once to understand it. Utility rows stay quiet and predictable.

screens.title: Car: nothing needs attention
screens.note: A compact No active alerts message appears only after usable checks. No repeated health score, reassuring diagnosis or technical status.

screens.title: Car: connecting
screens.note: The universal connection pill owns routine startup. No CEL, fault count, incomplete-check panel or false all-clear appears without evidence.

screens.title: Car: one adapter missing
screens.note: Engine findings remain useful while the transmission adapter reconnects. One logical car, one connection pill; no second dashboard or repeated warnings.

screens.title: Car: offline with previous activity
screens.note: Previous alerts are explicitly from the last drive, not current vehicle truth. History and settings remain accessible.

screens.title: Car: all reported codes hidden
screens.note: Identical to the quiet screen when checks are complete. No hidden count, warning icon, ghost alert row or invitation to inspect filtered codes.

screens.title: Car: only the remaining issue
screens.note: Hiding a fault removes that row and its counts. A separate coolant threshold alert remains. Filtering is not a controller-wide mute.

screens.title: Alerts: the full current list
screens.note: Direct issue rows, ordered by attention priority. Current and History are separate tabs. No rules, exports or diagnostic tools mixed into the list.

screens.title: Fault: meaning before machinery
screens.note: One tap from Car. Plain-language lookup, exact code and controller, brief guidance and useful time context. No protocol fields or generic Details link.
screens.changeSummary: First proposal. Approve this screen or leave feedback; runtime implementation waits for the design decision.

screens.title: Fault: no trustworthy description
screens.note: A vehicle-specific code without a verified description is labelled honestly. No invented AI diagnosis or incorrect model lookup.
screens.changeSummary: First proposal. Approve this screen or leave feedback; runtime implementation waits for the design decision.

screens.title: Alert: useful context and actions
screens.note: Show the value recorded at the alert and its configured limit. Got it marks it seen; Snooze is only available for eligible noncritical alerts. No fake live phone reading.
screens.changeSummary: First proposal. Approve this screen or leave feedback; runtime implementation waits for the design decision.

screens.title: Alert: current reading unavailable
screens.note: Keep the recorded observation explicitly historical. Do not say the alert cleared or show obsolete active-only controls when the source is unavailable.
screens.changeSummary: First proposal. Approve this screen or leave feedback; runtime implementation waits for the design decision.

screens.title: History: just the timeline
screens.note: Human-readable events and time, without raw lifecycle names, severity labels, session IDs or repeated controller categories. Hidden content is projected out here too.
screens.changeSummary: First proposal. Approve this screen or leave feedback; runtime implementation waits for the design decision.

screens.title: History: empty after filtering
screens.note: No recorded alerts, with no hidden count or empty fault cards. Raw internal evidence is retained without surfacing in normal UI.
screens.changeSummary: First proposal. Approve this screen or leave feedback; runtime implementation waits for the design decision.

screens.title: Alert settings: rules in one place
screens.note: Useful reading names and limit summaries. The same existing alert owner serves Car and Gauge customization; notification permission remains a separate phone control.
screens.changeSummary: First proposal. Approve this screen or leave feedback; runtime implementation waits for the design decision.

screens.title: Edit a reading alert
screens.note: One focused editor with a useful limit first. Timing and reset stay behind Alert behavior. Save is one user action; only acknowledged gauge state shows saved.

screens.title: Add alert: any supported reading
screens.note: Search across the unified catalog, including transmission readings and future custom readings. Adapter topology never limits what can be selected.
screens.changeSummary: First proposal. Approve this screen or leave feedback; runtime implementation waits for the design decision.

screens.title: Advanced: manage hidden codes
screens.note: The only normal product surface that lists hidden codes. Exact vehicle and Engine/Transmission scope, reversible rules, and a precise applied state.
screens.changeSummary: First proposal. Approve this screen or leave feedback; runtime implementation waits for the design decision.

screens.title: Advanced: hide a code
screens.note: One exact code and controller. Hides code content throughout eGauge, including historical presentation and ordinary reports. Does not clear ECU codes.

screens.title: Advanced: an offline gauge
screens.note: Show acknowledgement per assigned gauge. A saved phone change cannot silently claim that an offline physical gauge has applied it. Routine screens never display the hidden codes.

screens.title: Car selection
screens.note: Browsing a different car does not silently reassign the connected gauge. Gauge associations remain explicit and per vehicle.

screens.title: Car settings
screens.note: Name, gauge and adapter management leave the everyday overview. Optional child adapter and hidden-code management remain under Advanced.

screens.title: Phone notification: one relevant event
screens.note: Specific title and meaningful context. Tap goes straight to the alert. Matching hidden-code notifications are cancelled or replaced, with no empty notification shell.

screens.title: Gauge: hidden-only versus visible fault
screens.note: Circular gauge preserves the current design. Complete hidden-only evidence produces no icon or count. A separate visible fault still produces the appropriate indication.

screens.note: Same hierarchy and fixed semantic meanings using existing eGauge light tokens. No new visual language or color-only states.

screens.note: Actual doubled text sizes in a dense detail view. Content scrolls while named actions remain accessible. Captured values stay immutable; Android TalkBack and font-scale qualification follow implementation.
